A Slack app in your workspace, so apps can post to approved channels and match people by email.

**Used by:** [OpenCRM](/docs/apps/crm) for team agents that post to Slack (optional).

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Slack account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/slack/callback
```

1. Open [api.slack.com/apps](https://api.slack.com/apps) and select **Create New App**. **From a manifest** is quickest: your coding agent can write one from the app's scopes.
2. Pick the workspace. Under **OAuth & Permissions**, add the redirect URI above as a redirect URL, and the bot scopes the apps you run need.
3. Under **Basic Information → App Credentials**, copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add slack
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  slack: { access: "read", scopes: ["channels.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `channels.read` | Channels (read-only) | `channels:read`, `groups:read` |
| `users.read` | Members (read-only) | `users:read` |
| `users.email` | Members' email addresses (read-only) | `users:read.email` |
| `messages.write` | Messages (post as the app) | `chat:write`, `chat:write.public`, `chat:write.customize` |
| `channels.join` | Channels (join public ones) | `channels:join` |
| `channels.manage` | Channels (create, manage and invite to; open DMs) | `channels:manage`, `groups:write`, `channels:write.invites`, `groups:write.invites`, `im:write` |
| `files.write` | Files (upload) | `files:write` |
| `user-channels.manage` | Channels (as the installing person: read, manage, invite to) | `channels:read`, `channels:write`, `groups:read`, `groups:write` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show slack` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Slack**.
